referenceSources.title: AMG-Mercedes 190E 2.5-16 Evolution II DTM - 1992
referenceSources.description:
This photograph captures the rear of a black-and-silver AMG Mercedes 190E 2.5-16 Evolution II DTM race car as it navigates a racetrack corner. The car’s widened fenders, large rear wing, and low stance emphasize its competition-ready setup. Prominent sponsor decals—Hugo Boss, Sonax, Bridgestone, and Shell—adorn the bodywork, while the Bäumler men’s fashion logo appears on the license panel.

Introduced in 1990 as a homologation special, the Evo II road car enabled Mercedes to field the competition version in the DTM series. By 1992, the racing Evo II had secured its first victory with Klaus Ludwig and saw strong championship finishes from Kurt Thiim and Bernd Schneider. Powered by a 2.5‑liter inline-four engine producing 370 hp, the lightweight, aerodynamic Evo II reached nearly 300 km/h, making it one of the era’s most iconic touring cars.
